newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS STRONGER ON U.S. UNIT.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS STRONGER ON U.S. UNIT.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar finished Friday firmer against the U.S. dollar despite early expectations that it would soften, dealers said.
They said that local players were selling a flood of foreign exchange, thereby boosting the local unit.
"It opened at around 11.1700/1800 but we saw the guys selling currency and it ended the day firmer," one dealer said.
"There was a flood of foreign currency on the market. Our local currency firmed against the U.S. dollar. There was a lot of money in the market," another dealer said.
On Friday the local unit finished at 11.1550/1650 on the U.S. dollar from 11.1650/1750 on Thursday.
The Zimbabwe dollar finished at 18.1320/1590 on sterling from 18.2900/3100, at 2.4910/4945 against the rand from 2.4800/5000 and at 6.5875/5950 on the mark from 6.6100/6300.
